Video by thetimes

A clip from Steven Bartlett's podcast Diary of a CEO has resurfaced on social media feeds where Bartlett suggests that society should "intervene" with partnering up incel men with women.⁠
⁠
In the episode, Dr K and Bartlett discuss the male loneliness epidemic, mentioning how some of these men who are caught in the dark corners of the internet are struggling to find partners, pass on their genes and therefore, will go extinct.⁠
⁠
Barlett asks the question three times to Dr K in the podcast, asking: "should society intervene to course correct that? Should we put systems in place to make sure that those men meet partners?"⁠
⁠
The video has sparked mass debate online, raising the question of whether Bartlett believes men are entitled to partners and reproduction⁠

The search results confirm Diary of a CEO episodes exist discussing incels, male loneliness, and dating apps, but don't provide enough detail to verify or contradict the specific quotes attributed to Bartlett. Without access to the actual clip or transcript, the claim cannot be definitively fact-checked.
